prompt:
Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed: `consume` was taking stock from the most recently received batch first. It now uses the batch that expires first, as `docs/DATA.md` requires. Batches with no expiry date go last; ties go to the batch received first, then the lower id. So lot HD-1022 is now used before HD-1026. I added two regression tests in `tests/stock.test.js` and a changelog entry. All 28 tests pass and lint is clean.
